content.title: Procedure Ladder | Layered Processing to Peel-Off Inspection
content.summary: Fix the same treatment surface and let different tools or materials gradually change the required state in the next step; only remove the covering layer once in the later stage, and finally use independent inspection actions to prove the stable results.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed processing surface + multi-tool single responsibility + layer-by-layer accumulation + single removal + two independent acceptances
quick_start.recommended_input: On the restoration table of the original museum, the cracked ivory ceramic mask is fixed on the charcoal frame. The restorer first dry brushes to remove dust from the crack mesh; the scanner passes through the repair area, and the transparent protective coating is only brushed along the verified cracks, and each tool is only responsible for one action; the oblique grazing light scans the ceramic, and the restorer uses a small magnifying glass to inspect it from a second angle. After two certifications, the repair surface remains stable.
required_anchors: Establish one stable treatment surface and baseline before application.
Give each tool or material a distinct visible duty.
Use one late covering-layer removal as the decisive reveal.
Verify the finished surface with a separate inspection action.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Fix the same treatment surface and let different tools or materials gradually change the required state in the next step; only remove the covering layer once in the later stage, and finally use independent inspection actions to prove the stable results.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one treatment surface and orientation, apply distinct tools or materials where each step changes the state needed by the next, accumulate a readable covering layer, perform one late removal or rinse, then use a separate inspection action to verify the stable finished surface.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable treatment surface and baseline before application.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting mid-process hides the initial condition.

invariants.rule: Give each tool or material a distinct visible duty.
invariants.purpose: Turns montage into a causal procedure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random tools provide no process logic.

invariants.rule: Keep intermediate layers relevant to the next step.
Use one late covering-layer removal as the decisive reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several repeated peels weaken the event.

invariants.rule: Verify the finished surface with a separate inspection action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending during removal leaves completion untested.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's face and beauty identity
skincare cream, serum and cosmetic device
mirror, mist and source treatment order
